messages:
IncidentBot: page triggered -> ALERT: enterprise vpc 'heliohealth-prod-us-east' experiencing 429 surge. 90th latency ok, but 429 rate jumped from 0.2% -> 12% in last 3m. Affected pool: dedicated-us-east-1a (tenant isolation triggered). Pager: @Anna L, @Ben K, @Maria S. Please ack and triage.

Anna L: acked. I'm oncall for SRE today, jumping in. Marcos is on call for infra but he's OOO this afternoon.

Ben K: looking at logs now. short summary: repeated POST /v1/generate with identical prompt signatures, ~2M req/min across 3 client tokens. Subnet origins: 10.12.5.0/24 and 10.12.8.0/24. Lots of retries (client backoff not configured).

Maria S: thanks Ben. Do we have customer ticket id? HelioHealth support said they didn't push any major release. Might be a downstream job.

Anna L: HelioHealth CSM opened INC-78921. They confirm a new batch job kicked off at ~08:04 UTC. It's hitting long-running streaming endpoints and causing KV cache thrash -> per-tenant rate checks are tripping -> 429.

Ben K: posting quick snippet of error pattern from dedicated pool logs:

```
2025-06-12T08:06:11Z pool=dedicated-us-east-1a tenant=heliohealth req_id=abc123 status=429 reason=quota_exceeded
2025-06-12T08:06:12Z pool=dedicated-us-east-1a tenant=heliohealth req_id=abc124 status=429 reason=kv_cache_miss
2025-06-12T08:06:13Z pool=dedicated-us-east-1a tenant=heliohealth req_id=abc125 status=200 latency=312ms
```

Ben K: looks like config for that tenant has aggressive per-token throttle combined with tiny burst window. We can either apply a temporary contract override (emergency lift) or reroute some traffic to a standby variant.

Anna L: I'm going to try a quick mitigation: create a temp burst exemption for heliohealth for 30m and enable routing to backup-dedicated pool if latencies hold.

Maria S: be careful with capacity. We only have 2 spare nodes in us-east. If we grant full lift we might impact other tenants. Suggest partial lift: increase per-minute token quota by 3x and set strict per-connection concurrency to limit head-of-line slow clients.

SRE Rotation: taking handoff from Anna in 10 minutes. Anna, please add a short runbook snippet in thread for whoever follows.

Anna L: copying runbook steps below (for quick execution via ops-api):

1) create emergency override:
```
curl -X POST https://ops.redwood/api/v1/overrides -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"tenant_id":"heliohealth","type":"burst_exempt","duration_minutes":30,"multiplier":3,"notes":"temp mitigation for job spike - monitored"}'
```
2) add routing rule to send 20% traffic to backup pool:
```
# update routing policy
curl -X PATCH https://ops.redwood/api/v1/routing/heliohealth -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" -d '{"split": [{"pool":"dedicated-us-east-1a","weight":80},{"pool":"dedicated-us-east-1b","weight":20}]}'
```
3) monitor token 429 rate and tail logs: `kubectl logs -f svc/ingress-proxy --selector=pool=dedicated-us-east-1a`

Anna L: applying override now. If anyone sees emergency-override stuck, ping me.

Ben K: I'm in metrics. Applying a temporary rule locally to test pattern match before we roll. If we see error rate drop to <1% in 5m, we keep.

Maria S: Contracts & Billing note: will this require a one-off charge? Contracts Bot, can you pre-authorize emergency credit? @Contracts Bot

Contracts Bot: tagging contracts on-call. Pre-authorization needed for out-of-policy burst lift. Please capture expected delta and ROI.

(2 minutes later)

Anna L: override applied: response 200, override_id=ovr_94f2, duration=30m. Routing patch queued.

Ben K: seeing immediate decrease in 429s from 12% -> 1.1% over last 90s. Latency stable. Good signal.

Maria S: great. Keep observing for 15m then we can extend if necessary. Anna, can you add a mitigation tag on INC-78921 and notify HelioHealth CSM?

Anna L: done. Added tag "mitigated-temporary-override" and DM'd CSM. HelioHealth says their job can be throttled on their side if we need full stop.

SRE Rotation: taking over now from Anna. I'm starting a 30m monitor window then we'll decide next step. Leaving ops-note: revert override after 30m unless extended.

Ben K: long-term action: prod config needs a more forgiving burst window for dedicated pools with streaming workloads. I'll open a follow-up PR for tuning default throttle config and add a hint in onboarding docs for enterprise VPC tenants.

Anna L: filing post-incident checklist: 1) confirm billing delta with Contracts; 2) update config PR; 3) schedule postmortem with HelioHealth and Solutions. Assigning owners: Contracts -> @Contracts Bot (follow-up), Config PR -> @Ben K, Postmortem -> @Maria S.

Maria S: thanks team. closing thread for now; SRE Rotation will update when override expires or if further action required. :thumbsup:
